newsitem.title: JAPAN: Oki Elec to launch phone joint venture in China.
newsitem.headline: Oki Elec to launch phone joint venture in China.

text.p: Oki Electric Industry Co Ltd said on Tuesday that it and a Chinese telecommunications firm would set up a joint venture in China in May to manufacture and sell telephone systems and switchboards.
The joint venture will sell its products to markets in Europe, Oceania, Japan and Southeast Asian countries as well as China, Oki said in a statement.
The joint venture will be capitalised at $7.3 million.
Oki will hold a 70 percent stake in the firm, while the Chinese partner, Guoguang Electronic Corp, will own 30 percent, the statement said.
